## Checklist

- [ ] The project builds (`npm run build`)
- [ ] Lint, format check, and tests pass (`npm run lint`, `npm run format:check`, `npm test`)
- [ ] Follows [docs/CODING_STANDARDS.md](../docs/CODING_STANDARDS.md)
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, or `.env` files committed
- [ ] Tested offline (DevTools > Network > Offline) if the change touches the waiter flow or the service worker
- [ ] UI text is in Spanish; code, comments, and docs are in English
- [ ] Docs updated (README, `.env.example`) if applicable. `CHANGELOG.md` is generated by release-please
